## Rules

- Never run migrations on prod without a tested rollback.
- Seed scripts in `scripts/seed.py` — safe to re-run, idempotent.
- Never delete columns — deprecate first, remove in a later migration.
- All queries use parameterized statements. No string concat with user data.
